g.text: Damodaran dataset: --region (default US) and --year (default the current year).
Tickers: --universe names the tickers CSV; --limit N takes the first N tickers.
Exit code: the worst of the requested sources; Damodaran failure 1, other sources 2.

yes: status partial; an empty side
keeps its old rows (upsert returns before it deletes)

region = --region, year = --year or the current year

EDGAR label: Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) description

and treats dash variants alike
every target on the Damodaran industry list,

yes: skipped, no import

which facts become a row?
annual: a duration of 350 to 380 days from a 10-K or 10-K/A
quarterly: a duration of 80 to 100 days from a 10-Q or 10-Q/A,
for a column stored quarterly
an instant fact joins the row with the same period end
any other fact is dropped
which concept fills a column?
per column and period end, the first concept in the list
with an accepted fact wins; later concepts fill only empty ends
e.g. revenue: Revenues, then
RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, ...
is_restated: a fact used for the period comes from an amendment
derive aggregates, only when not reported, from
earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT): EBITDA = EBIT + depreciation
free cash flow = operating cash flow − capex
working capital = current assets − current liabilities
an aggregate with a missing input stays empty
label each row with its fiscal year
annual: fiscal year = calendar year of the period end
quarter: year of the next annual end within 380 days,
else previous annual end + 1;
numbered back or forward in 91.3-day steps
two rows with one label: the later period end is kept
annual diluted share count a whole scale off its peers?
ratio = median of the other positive annual counts ÷ count
factors tried: 1,000,000, then 1,000
yes if factor ÷ 2 ≤ ratio ≤ factor × 2 (tolerance 2)
needs at least 3 other counts
yes: count × factor, counted as rescaled
provider rate limit hit (probe or import)?
yes: this ticker and every remaining one are deferred, not failed
deferred tickers are not counted in the failure rate
status of the run
failure rate = failed ÷ attempted
at most 5%: success; at most 25%: partial; above 25%: error
not success: exit code 2
--only-missing?
yes: only tickers with no stored price are requested,
so no quota is spent on priced ones
newest stored bar on or after the last weekday before today?
yes: ticker skipped, no request

never priced first, then oldest newest bar first;

prices_daily.currency = companies.currency

yes: this ticker and every remaining one are deferred, not failed;
the run prints tickers deferred and daily.sh runs another round
status of the run

at most 5%: success; at most 25%: partial; above 25%: error

g.text: wacc.xls: beta, cost of equity, cost of debt, tax rate, cost of capital, debt weight D/(D+E).
ctryprem.xls, sheet 'ERPs by country': country, region, rating, total equity risk premium, country risk premium. A failure stops the remaining downloads.
pbvdata.xls: price to book multiple, return on equity, return on invested capital.
vebitda.xls: enterprise value to earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) multiple.
psdata.xls: enterprise value to sales multiple.
A missing tax rate counts as 0. beta_unlevered is empty when D/E is empty.
Gap: the US risk-free rate is written into every country row; the per-currency rate of the architecture decision record (ADR) 0005 is not implemented.
Gap: only the US Damodaran dataset is ingested (ADR 0005 not implemented); --region other than US is refused.
A label without a row leaves industry_damodaran empty and logs a warning; the sector rules skip that company later.
A missing mapping file gives an empty mapping.
A configured path that does not exist falls back to the packaged copy.
Company row: name, exchange and industry from the submissions; currency USD; industry_damodaran from the mapping.
The source column is restamped as the provider name, not sec_edgar, so the skip check above finds the stored filings.
One refresh_log row per ticker, source = the provider name.
A failed ticker is recorded and the run continues.
FMP statements come already parsed; the period, concept, fiscal, derive and share rules below apply to SEC EDGAR only.
EdgarPricedProvider is the EDGAR half shared by the Tiingo and Stooq providers.
A quarter without an annual end within a year takes the label of the filing that reported it first.
A quarter number outside 1 to 4 also takes that label.
No such filing label: the row is dropped.
Tiingo is the default source: status 429 is a rate limit.
Stooq is the alternative (BOT_DATA_PROVIDER=edgar-stooq): CSV files from BOT_STOOQ_DIR, else stooq.com.
FMP is the optional provider (BOT_DATA_PROVIDER=fmp). Its market cap is the marketCap field of its prices, or the current market cap when the newest bar is at most 7 days old.
Gap: docs/plano/estado.py still calls edgar-stooq the default provider; the code default is edgar-tiingo.
The rate of the nearest prior date is used, never a later one.
Gap: under the SEC EDGAR providers (edgar-tiingo, the default, and edgar-stooq) the FX refresh stores no rates for non-USD currencies; only Financial Modeling Prep supplies them.

text.tspan: bot refresh --prices, repeated until no tickers deferred
(BOT_PRICE_ROUNDS, default 10 rounds;
BOT_PRICE_RETRY_PAUSE, default 3600 s apart)
a failing round stops the loop
then bot refresh --fx, which runs even when prices failed
hourly bot refresh --prices --only-missing
until every company has a price
